title: Release cutover checklist - 2026-03-21 (Elliot)
content:
Personal scratchpad for today's cutover. Mostly checklist + quick reminders. Will update in real time during cutover.

Context:
- Release: service-infra v1.18.0 (includes hotfixes and backports for KV cache bug).
- Cutover window: 2026-03-21 02:00 - 04:00 UTC (low traffic).
- Oncall: Jordan (primary), Aisha (secondary). I'm acting release lead.
- Goal: deploy infra changes + db migration, validate smoke tests, keep customer impact <1min.

Pre-cutover (T-48h -> T-1h):
- [x] Finalize rollout plan in Confluence (deployment-runbook-556).
- [x] Verify backports merged: INF-2456 (kv-cache fix), INF-2461 (daemon crashes on OOM).
- [x] PRs ready: infra PR #142 (merged to release branch), note: requires config update to autoscaler.
- [ ] Confirm infra capacity reservation with infra team (email sent, waiting reply). -- TODO follow up at 2026-03-20 17:00 PST
- [x] Run full ci-integrations on release branch (green).
- [x] Notify #release-coordination + temp pinned thread for updates.
- [x] Prepare rollback artifacts (previous docker tags, rollback migration script).

Cutover timeline (local times and UTC):
- 01:30 UTC: Final go/no-go check (all leads on call).
- 01:45 UTC: Pause incoming batch jobs and disable autoscaler burst.
- 02:00 UTC: Start deployment to canary group (10% of cluster nodes).
- 02:10 UTC: Run canary smoke tests (see smoke test checklist below).
- 02:20 UTC: If canary good -> gradual rollout to remaining nodes over 20m with 2m pause windows.
- 02:50 UTC: Run post-rollout verification, enable batch jobs.
- 03:10 UTC: Monitor 30m for errors/latency regression, if stable declare success.

Quick commands & references (put here so I don't have to hunt):
- Rollback previous image: kubectl set image deployment/serving-runtime serving-runtime=redwood/serving-runtime:1.17.9 -n infra-prod
- Migration rollback: sql/run_rollback_kv_cache.sql (in infra-tooling repo).
- Check pods: kubectl get pods -n infra-prod -o wide | grep serving-runtime
- Autoscaler toggle: infra-scripts/toggle_autoscaler.sh --env prod --off

Backports and special notes:
- INF-2456 (kv cache prefix bug) -> cherry-picked to release branch (sha: a1b2c3). Required config change: kv_cache.enabled=true -> true (no change) but kv_cache.max_prefix set to 1024 (was 512).
- INF-2461 (daemon OOM) -> included with memory guard; note: we bumped container memory to 12Gi on canary only. Make sure SLI thresholds updated.
- Confirmed with Applied ML that quantized models test still passing on canary nodes.

Smoke test checklist (canary + post-rollout):
- [ ] 5 sample generation requests (gpt-like) latency < 220ms p50, < 600ms p95 on canary node.
- [ ] Run embedding batch job (10k rows) against canary, check throughput ~ unchanged (+/-10%).
- [ ] KV cache prefix regression test (unit test harness) -> pass.
- [ ] Service health endpoints ( /healthz, /metrics ) return 200 and metrics exported.
- [ ] Logs: no OOM errors or repeated crashes in last 10m.
- [ ] Error budget: no increase >0.2% in 5m error rate vs baseline.

Communication plan:
- Pre-cutover: post pinned message in #release-coordination with timeline and oncall list. (Done)
- During cutover: update Slack thread every major step (canary start, canary pass/fail, 50% rollout, complete).
- Post-cutover: summary message + link to smoke test results and incident page (if any).
- External comms: if customer-facing impact >1min, Ops will draft status page update and send to Customer Success.

Rollback criteria (immediate):
- Canary fail (smoke tests fail), or repeated 5xx spikes >0.5% sustained for 5m in prod traffic during rollout.
- Memory OOMs on more than 2 nodes within 10m.
- Any data migration error or corrupted rows detected.
Rollback steps (brief):
1) Pause rollout, set autoscaler off.
2) Deploy previous image (1.17.9) to affected deployments.
3) Run migration rollback script if migration ran (check migration log).
4) Restore config (kv_cache.max_prefix revert), verify health.
5) Postmortem -> assign INF incident ticket.

Monitoring & dashboards to watch (links in Confluence):
- Per-route latency dashboard (console -> infra -> per-route).
- Token-level cost/latency table for canary nodes.
- Pod restart count (SRE dashboard).
- Logs: /prod/serving-runtime on Kibana.

Open questions / follow-ups (notes to self):
- Need confirmation from infra on whether autoscaler toggle script fully removes pending scale-ups (rare race). Jordan to confirm.
- Who will press the status page update if external impact? Aisha volunteered but need backup.
- Confirm whether any customer config pins to old kv_cache.max_prefix value; if so we should coordinate with CS.

Post-cutover housekeeping:
- [ ] Update release notes (short blurb + link to PR #142).
- [ ] Tag release branch with v1.18.0 and push changelog.
- [ ] Create postmortem template if rollback happened.
- [ ] Schedule follow-up with Applied ML to verify no model regressions (1 week).

Notes to self / scratchy thoughts:
- If we see slight p95 increase but no errors, consider throttling new autoscaler config and monitor 1h before calling rollback.
- Keep an eye on cost spike from autoscaler misconfig.
- Remember to mute alerts that will fire during planned migration to avoid noise (list of alerts in runbook).

-- end of scratchpad. Updating live during cutover.
